# Book Release

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/BookRelease>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A concrete published edition or release of a book — an out-of-universe information object and rights-bearing publication artifact. A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Distinct from the in-universe narrative frame it contributes to; linked via [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a concrete published edition or release of a book — the rights-bearing, ISBN-carrying publication artifact at the [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the abstract literary work the edition realises (use [`gmeow:LiteraryWork`](gmeow-LiteraryWork.md)) and avoid conflating it with the in-universe narrative frame it sources (link by [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md)).

### How to use

- Type the edition [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md), carry its ISBN on [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) and [`gmeow:mediaType`](../properties/gmeow-mediaType.md) / [`gmeow:extent`](../properties/gmeow-extent.md); link the abstract work it manifests and the narrative frame it sources via [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md).

### Examples

- ex:firstEdition a [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md); [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) "978-0-13-468599-1"; [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md) ex:narrativeFrame.
